trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Confirmed the failure**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of ~0.18.
2. **Identified the target version**: v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back**: All production regions are now running v2.3.0 (rollback rolled out successfully).
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the failed health checks and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation by the on-call engineer.
